dialogue_texts: You think of glohm as a curse, and I simply came to confront the origin.
You have a tenacity that is as annoying as it is effective, My Majesty.
Very well. My daughter isn't missing in the way you fear.
Tenacity is one thing, but stubbornness in the face is simply pathetic. But more importantly, where is Flandre?
She is currently in no man's land, where the barrier is thinnest.
She's trying to understand why you rubbed the curse of glohm off some maid.
If she lingers in thin places trying to find logic in my work...
At the very edge of the world, she isn't just looking for answers.
A beacon in the dark only makes it easier for me to find her. Consider this conversation case closed.
You shouldn't celebrate too early because the wounded Berenice is calling for help.
